title: Sales Tax Collected tab shows Date, Invoice Status and Customer filters
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Reports pages. Whether the filter option lists differ by role is to confirm — pending Branko's PRD.
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Reports area of the app with some sample data present.
steps: 1. Open the Reports area and go to the Sales Tax (Collected tab) report.
2. Look at the filter buttons shown above the report table.
expected: 1. On the Sales Tax report's Collected tab, three filter buttons are shown: Date, Invoice Status and Customer.
2. The report has two view tabs: Collected and All Tax Rates.
2. Note: in the design the report body uses a sample placeholder table, so only the title, tabs and filter buttons are design-confirmed here; the real report columns come from Branko's PRD.
spec_ref: Filters (Epic key TBD); Figma 11903-10573 (Reports filters); design-notes.md §B.6 #10
notes: Design-only (title/tabs/chips). Report body is a design placeholder. Option lists pending Branko's PRD.
